From bd53280ef042301ea9663824568ecba5a88b2f9d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Janusz Krzysztofik <janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2019 15:32:31 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/drv: Fix incorrect resolution of merge conflict

Commit f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next") incorrectly
resolved a merge conflict related to a patch having been merged twice:
- commit 3f04e0a6cfeb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  introduced as a standalone fix via drm-fixes branch,
- commit 1ee57d4d75fb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  applied as patch 1/2 of a series on drm-next branch.
That incorrect resolution of the conflict effectively reverted a change
introduced to drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c by patch 2/2 of that series -
commit ba3bf37e150a ("drm/drv: drm_dev_unplug(): Move out drm_dev_put()
call").  Fix it.

Fixes: f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next")
Signed-off-by: Janusz Krzysztofik <janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Dave Airlie <airlied@redhat.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20190417133232.16232-1-janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
index e87799e3e7ff..50d849d1bc6e 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
@@ -508,7 +508,6 @@ void drm_dev_unplug(struct drm_device *dev)
 	synchronize_srcu(&drm_unplug_srcu);
 
 	drm_dev_unregister(dev);
-	drm_dev_put(dev);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(drm_dev_unplug);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c`**
   - **Line Removed**: The line `drm_dev_put(dev);` was removed from the `drm_dev_unplug` function. This change restores the behavior of the function to what it was before the incorrect merge conflict resolution.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c` addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (f06ddb53096b) that incorrectly resolved a merge conflict. The removal of the line `drm_dev_put(dev);` corrects the functionality of the `drm_dev_unplug` function, which had been altered due to the merge conflict. This fix ensures that the function behaves as intended, aligning it with the original changes made in commit ba3bf37e150a.

Here is the commit message:
drm/drv: Fix incorrect resolution of merge conflict

Commit f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next") incorrectly
resolved a merge conflict related to a patch having been merged twice:
- commit 3f04e0a6cfeb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  introduced as a standalone fix via drm-fixes branch,
- commit 1ee57d4d75fb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  applied as patch 1/2 of a series on drm-next branch.
That incorrect resolution of the conflict effectively reverted a change
introduced to drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c by patch 2/2 of that series -
commit ba3bf37e150a ("drm/drv: drm_dev_unplug(): Move out drm_dev_put()
call").  Fix it.

Fixes: f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next")
Signed-off-by: Janusz Krzysztofik <janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Dave Airlie <airlied@redhat.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20190417133232.16232-1-janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect resolution of a merge conflict during the back merge of two branches, which led to the removal of a necessary call to `drm_dev_put(dev);` in the `drm_dev_unplug` function. This call is essential for proper resource management and cleanup, and its removal effectively reverted a critical change that was intended to improve the device unplugging process.

Here is the patch:
  */
 void drm_dev_unplug(struct drm_device *dev)
 {
 	/*
 	 * After synchronizing any critical read section is guaranteed to see
 	 * the new value of ->unplugged, and any critical section which might
 	 * still have seen the old value of ->unplugged is guaranteed to have
 	 * finished.
 	 */
 	dev->unplugged = true;
 	synchronize_srcu(&drm_unplug_srcu);
 
 	drm_dev_unregister(dev);
-	drm_dev_put(dev);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(drm_dev_unplug);

Reason:
The removal of the `drm_dev_put(dev);` call during the merge conflict resolution led to improper resource management and cleanup in the `drm_dev_unplug` function. This call is essential for decrementing the reference count of the device, which can result in memory leaks or dangling pointers if omitted.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
drm_dev_put(dev);
```
Reason:
Reintroducing the `drm_dev_put(dev);` call ensures that the reference count of the device is correctly decremented after it has been unregistered. This restores the intended functionality of the `drm_dev_unplug` function, ensuring proper resource management and preventing potential memory issues.
